depth.why: Python has no depth limit (only RecursionError near 1000); C++ refuses values nested deeper than 32, checked before parsing

lone_surrogate.why: Python keeps a lone \uD800-\uDFFF escape as a lone surrogate, which is not text; C++ refuses it

overflow.why: Python turns a number past the f64 range into inf (or an exact int); C++ refuses it, like NaN and Infinity

bom.why: C++ skips a leading UTF-8 byte order mark; Python refuses it, and no sender writes one

nul.why: C++ stops reading at a raw NUL byte, taking the JSON before it; Python refuses it, and no sender writes one
